text:
Type: striped flatwoven area rug
Use: defining a seating or dining area; living room, dining room, bedroom, hallway
Style: Scandinavian, modern, minimalist
Materials: flat-woven yarn with a handmade texture
Colors: black, off-white
Shape: rectangle with bold horizontal stripes split into three panels, the middle panel offset, crisp graphic pattern, flat and thin
Feel: graphic, crisp, bold, timeless
Goes with: white walls, light or dark wood, black metal, grey textiles; Scandinavian, modern or monochrome rooms

product.name: STOCKHOLM
product.description: Handwoven by skilled craftspeople, each one is unique. Made in India in organised weaving centres with good working conditions and fair wages.
